Is this an open source project?
Vonova was architected and developed by the dedicated engineering team at Vonova Tech, built from scratch to serve modern education.
What is the goal of Vonova?
What are you trying to achieve?
Our mission is to democratize education by providing high-quality, AI-powered learning tools accessible to everyone, everywhere.
Where did the name come from?
The name 'Vonova' is derived from 'Von', inspired by the scientist John von Neumann, and 'Nova', which signifies a new beginning or openness.
Security is our top priority. We use industry-standard encryption and never sell your personal data to third parties.
Vonova is hosted on secure, high-speed cloud servers to ensure 99.9% uptime and fast access globally.
Do I have to pay to use the site?
Registration and accessing free courses are completely free. You only pay for premium courses or specific subscription plans.
Do I have to watch ads?
Vonova provides a distraction-free learning environment. We do not display third-party advertisements on our platform.
Can I use it on iPad?
Yes, Vonova is fully responsive and optimized to work smoothly on desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones.
Can I use it without wifi?
The website requires an internet connection
Yes, we integrate advanced Generative AI models to power features like the Roadmap Generator, PDF Summary, and AI Tutor.
We release updates and new features weekly to ensure the platform remains cutting-edge and bug-free.
Vonova is designed for everyone: individual learners, professional instructors, and educational institutions looking for a modern LMS.
Vonova stands out by combining standard learning with advanced AI tools, gamification, and social community features in one place.
Can I put it on CV?

We optimize our code and use global CDNs to ensure the platform loads instantly, even on slower connections.
We provide unlimited cloud storage for course materials and assignments for all our users.
We use gamification elements like points and badges to make learning fun and keep you motivated to reach your goals.
